infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Map Cam needs camera access to capture GPS-stamped photos and videos.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Map Cam uses the microphone when video audio is enabled.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Map Cam uses your location to place GPS information on photos and videos.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: Map Cam can use your location while the app is in use for site documentation.
